##### Technologies Supporting Mission-Critical Applications

Aptiv has the products, technologies and expertise that companies rely on to deliver performance and
reliability for the long haul. Our software runs intelligent edge devices from vehicles to
airplanes, and from industrial robots to cellular base stations, while our hardware and connectors
handle the toughest environmental conditions.

## What We Do

# no js

[Two orange robots working in production line.]

### Mobility

A Tier One supplier to global OEMs, Kautex designs and manufactures plastic fuel systems solutions,
selective catalytic reduction systems (SCR), castings and camera/sensor cleaning solutions.

[ Read More ][70]

# no js

[Car headlamp with cleaning system spraying water particles.]

### Clear Vision Systems (CVS)

From camera cleaning to sensor-solutions for autonomous driving test programs, our Clear Vision
Systems (CVS) solutions combine safety and convenience.

[ Read More ][71]

# no js

[Employee holding jerrycan inside of manufacturing facility.]

### Packaging

A pioneer in the production of plastic packaging, Kautex provides a wide variety of product
offerings from standard catalog items to customer specific solutions.

[ Read More ][72]

## Join Our Team

Founded in 1935, Kautex is world-known as being a pioneer in polymer processing. Today, we are one
of the top automotive suppliers to OEMs across the globe manufacturing battery systems, plastic fuel
systems, clear vision systems and castings, as well as industrial packaging.

# Fluid Thinking, Thermal Innovation

We are TI Fluid Systems: the industry leader in thermal solutions and fluid systems for vehicle
manufacturers across the world.

## Empowering the future of mobility

TI Fluid Systems designs and manufactures thermal management and fluid handling systems that improve
efficiency, performance and sustainability for forward-thinking organisations worldwide.

[Find out more][22]
* [Alfa Romeo logo]
* [Land Rover logo]
* [General Motors logo]
* [Fiat logo]

* [Aston Martin logo]

## Products

Working across fluid carrying systems and thermal technologies to provide complete fluid solutions,
we design and manufacture high-quality, high-efficiency products for automakers producing the
vehicles of today and tomorrow.
* [ITMA 1.4]
  
  ### ITMA 1.4
  
  The ITMA 1.4 combines all mandated coolant distribution functions into one compact module. It
  provides maximized integration of functional content for autonomous coolant module.
* [R1234YF]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### R1234YF
  
  The Accumulator for R1234yf refrigerant combines the medium storage as well as gas / liquid
  separation including moisture extraction to protect the e-Compressor against liquid stroke.
* [Rubber Aluminum Refrigerant Line]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### Rubber Aluminum Refrigerant Line
  
  The traditional aluminium rubber refrigerant lines combine rigid aluminium tubes with rubber hose
  sections and connect the refrigerant loop key components such as compressor, ambient heat
  exchanger, valves, internal heat exchanger and the accumulator.
* [TPRL]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### TPRL
  
  TPRL is a breakthrough innovative technology for suction and liquid line applications in vehicle
  refrigerant systems. The smart combination of plastic materials replaces traditional metal and
  rubber-based tubes.
* [IBFD]
  
  Coolant Components,
  
  Thermal Management – Coolant
  
  ### IBFD
  
  IBFD is a blow molded compact manifold specifically for inner battery coolant distribution. It is
  designed to substitute multiple number of single coolant lines into one unit within the limited
  battery inner space.
* [ITMR 1.4]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### ITMR 1.4
  
  The ITMR 1.4 incorporates the key traditional separated refrigerant flow control functions with
  parts such as Compressor, Valves, Sensors, Heat Exchanger and Accumulator-IHX, for refrigerant
  conditioning and storage, to provide a Plug & Play module.
* [ITMR 1.3]
  
  ### ITMR 1.3
  
  The ITMR 1.3 incorporates traditional separated refrigerant flow control functions with features
  for highly efficient pressure and flow management within a compact module.
* [ITMR 1.2]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### ITMR 1.2
  
  The ITMR 1.2 valve block unit combines single valves, traditionally separated within a refrigerant
  loop, into one single compact and modular valve unit.
* [ITMA 1.3]
  
  ### ITMA 1.3
  
  The ITMA 1.3 combines coolant transport and distribution functions and in addition incorporates
  the heat exchanger (Chiller) as the heat transfer interface between coolant and the refrigerant
  system.
* [Hydrogen Lines]
  
  Hydrogen
  
  ### Hydrogen Lines
  
  The Hydrogen Supply Lines ensures the distribution of hydrogen at low pressure from hydrogen
  regulator at the hydrogen tanks to the fuel cell processing system. The Hydrogen Storage Lines
  connect the hydrogen tanks and the regulator on the high-pressure side of the supply system

We have always developed products with increased efficiency and lower emissions in mind. Now, we’re
leading the shift to electrification with tailored solutions that enable our customers to lower
their impact further without sacrificing quality.

Our five global technical centers and seven regional support centers drive our research and
development efforts, enabling us to find solutions to the industry’s most complex challenges.

# Fluid Thinking, Thermal Innovation

We are TI Fluid Systems: the industry leader in thermal solutions and fluid systems for vehicle
manufacturers across the world.

## Empowering the future of mobility

TI Fluid Systems designs and manufactures thermal management and fluid handling systems that improve
efficiency, performance and sustainability for forward-thinking organisations worldwide.

[Find out more][22]

## Products

Working across fluid carrying systems and thermal technologies to provide complete fluid solutions,
we design and manufacture high-quality, high-efficiency products for automakers producing the
vehicles of today and tomorrow.
* [ITMA 1.4]
  
  ### ITMA 1.4
  
  The ITMA 1.4 combines all mandated coolant distribution functions into one compact module. It
  provides maximized integration of functional content for autonomous coolant module.
* [R1234YF]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### R1234YF
  
  The Accumulator for R1234yf refrigerant combines the medium storage as well as gas / liquid
  separation including moisture extraction to protect the e-Compressor against liquid stroke.
* [Rubber Aluminum Refrigerant Line]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### Rubber Aluminum Refrigerant Line
  
  The traditional aluminium rubber refrigerant lines combine rigid aluminium tubes with rubber hose
  sections and connect the refrigerant loop key components such as compressor, ambient heat
  exchanger, valves, internal heat exchanger and the accumulator.
* [TPRL]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### TPRL
  
  TPRL is a breakthrough innovative technology for suction and liquid line applications in vehicle
  refrigerant systems. The smart combination of plastic materials replaces traditional metal and
  rubber-based tubes.
* [IBFD]
  
  Coolant Components,
  
  Thermal Management – Coolant
  
  ### IBFD
  
  IBFD is a blow molded compact manifold specifically for inner battery coolant distribution. It is
  designed to substitute multiple number of single coolant lines into one unit within the limited
  battery inner space.
* [ITMR 1.4]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### ITMR 1.4
  
  The ITMR 1.4 incorporates the key traditional separated refrigerant flow control functions with
  parts such as Compressor, Valves, Sensors, Heat Exchanger and Accumulator-IHX, for refrigerant
  conditioning and storage, to provide a Plug & Play module.
* [ITMR 1.3]
  
  ### ITMR 1.3
  
  The ITMR 1.3 incorporates traditional separated refrigerant flow control functions with features
  for highly efficient pressure and flow management within a compact module.
* [ITMR 1.2]
  
  Thermal Management – Refrigerant
  
  ### ITMR 1.2
  
  The ITMR 1.2 valve block unit combines single valves, traditionally separated within a refrigerant
  loop, into one single compact and modular valve unit.
* [ITMA 1.3]
  
  ### ITMA 1.3
  
  The ITMA 1.3 combines coolant transport and distribution functions and in addition incorporates
  the heat exchanger (Chiller) as the heat transfer interface between coolant and the refrigerant
  system.
* [Hydrogen Lines]
  
  Hydrogen
  
  ### Hydrogen Lines
  
  The Hydrogen Supply Lines ensures the distribution of hydrogen at low pressure from hydrogen
  regulator at the hydrogen tanks to the fuel cell processing system. The Hydrogen Storage Lines
  connect the hydrogen tanks and the regulator on the high-pressure side of the supply system

# Serving the Automotive Industry as an Innovative Tier 1 Supplier

**aft automotive GmbH is an international tier 1 automotive supplier, based in Greven in the state
of North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. At our five international locations, we produce plastic and
stainless steel tubing systems and functional components for hydraulic and pneumatic control in
vehicles of all kinds.**

**Forward-Looking Automotive Engineering**

We have experienced engineers and technicians who work closely with our customers to develop
outstanding, efficient solutions to meet the complex challenges of today’s automotive industry.
aft-automotive uses state-of-the-art technologies and methods, to develop outstanding, innovative
and reliable products, which make us a strong player in this industry.

**A Partner to Automotive Producers Worldwide**

We are partners with global Tier1s and leading OEMs. More than 40 customers worldwide depend on our
products’ high quality, reliability, and especially on our strong innovative problem-solving
competence. Our priorities are a high level of customer satisfaction, top-notch service and constant
development of new products, whilst improving our existing ones.

General Motors Supplier Quality Excellence Award 2022

### Our production site in Greven was awarded the "General Motors Supplier Quality Excellence
### Award"!


This award honors GM's highest performing manufacturing sites. Suppliers receiving the SQEA award
have met or exceeded very stringent quality performance criteria and have also received
cross-functional support from across the GM organization for calendar year 2022.

### The Foundation of Our Work

Our staff’s enthusiasm for and devotion to innovation and sustainability are the basis for a steady
stream of creative developments.

### Our Motto

Passion for Innovation

### Our Goals

To create solutions which are constantly one step ahead of the competition. Provide innovative
leadership and dependability to all our customers and partners. Drive responsible action and share
success in a spirit of partnership.

stainless steel tubing systems and functional components for hydraulic and pneumatic control in
vehicles of all kinds.**

**Forward-Looking Automotive Engineering**

We have experienced engineers and technicians who work closely with our customers to develop
outstanding, efficient solutions to meet the complex challenges of today’s automotive industry.
aft-automotive uses state-of-the-art technologies and methods, to develop outstanding, innovative
and reliable products, which make us a strong player in this industry.

**A Partner to Automotive Producers Worldwide**

We are partners with global Tier1s and leading OEMs. More than 40 customers worldwide depend on our
products’ high quality, reliability, and especially on our strong innovative problem-solving
competence. Our priorities are a high level of customer satisfaction, top-notch service and constant
development of new products, whilst improving our existing ones.

General Motors Supplier Quality Excellence Award 2022

### Our production site in Greven was awarded the "General Motors Supplier Quality Excellence
### Award"!


This award honors GM's highest performing manufacturing sites. Suppliers receiving the SQEA award
have met or exceeded very stringent quality performance criteria and have also received
cross-functional support from across the GM organization for calendar year 2022.

### The Foundation of Our Work

Our staff’s enthusiasm for and devotion to innovation and sustainability are the basis for a steady
stream of creative developments.

### Our Motto

Passion for Innovation

### Our Goals

To create solutions which are constantly one step ahead of the competition. Provide innovative
leadership and dependability to all our customers and partners. Drive responsible action and share
success in a spirit of partnership.

Carrier Safety Administration.

## Engineering Capabilities

Engineering team specializes in process sequence finalization, layout planning, fixture DAP, line

production readiness.

AutoForm ensuring manufacturing feasiblity and technological excellence.

## Technologies

**Battery Trays **
Are designed to efficiently house and manage EV battery cells, ensuring performance, safety, and
longevity in demanding applications.
**Aluminium cooling tubes **
Support thermal management in EV battery trays, maintaining optimal battery performance and safety
standards
**Stamping Technology**
High-tensile material processing with different grades on tonnage ranging from 250 T to 1500 T.
**Robotic & Manual Welding**
Incorporates MIG, TIG, Projection, laser welding, friction stir welding (FSW) with high-strength and
reliable assemblies.
**Heavy Fabrication & Surface Treatment**
Features CNC machining, laser cutting, automated assembly, and corrosion-resistant coatings for
durability and performance.

 

 

[ASAL - A tata Enterprise]

ASAL a [TATA Autocomp Systems Limited][82] subsidiary and a part of [TATA][83] Enterprise was
incorporated as a Public Limited Company under the Companies Act, 1956 on March 13, 1990 as JBM
Tools Limited and subsequently, on August 1, 2003 the name was changed to Automotive Stampings and
Assemblies Limited.

[ASAL Story][84]

held by the Public. The shares of the Company are listed on NSE and BSE.

### Our Industry Services

Ceeto has been providing custom metal stamping services for various industries and delivering deep
draw component solutions to customers worldwide on time.
Energy Storage
Ceeto has been providing lots of battery cases and enclosures in energy storage industries. With the
rapid development of national economy, the demand for energy is increasing day by day. Traditional
fossil energy is increasingly consumed and brings serious environmental pollution. The integrated
grid-connection of renewable energy and the peak regulation and frequency modulation of large-scale
power grid are inseparable from advanced energy storage technology. The flow battery not only
ensures the storage of intermittent energy sources such as solar, wind and tidal power, but also
converts electricity from off-peak to peak demand, thus maintaining a stable balance of power
consumption and enhancing the stability of the grid.
Medical Device Components
Ceeto is proud to design and manufacture metal medical sterilizer mainly using high-level stainless
steel material and to offer customized solutions for a wide range of metal applications. From
developing the initial prototype product design and building a prototype to manufacturing the
finished high quality products. In medical sterilizer, especially medical barrel which much more
complex with deep drawing technology up to depth 650mm, as well as laser cutting, bending, argon arc
welding, laser welding and high quality surface treatment.
Military & Defense
Material properties and applications can be divided into structural materials and functional
materials, which are mainly used in the ordnance industry. Structural materials mainly use
mechanical and physical and chemical properties of materials to meet the requirements of high
strength, high stiffness, high hardness, high temperature resistance, wear resistance, corrosion
resistance and radiation resistance. At present, metal materials applied in the military field
mainly include the following categories such as magnesium alloy, high-strength steel and Advanced
titanium alloy.
Oil & Gas
Metal tanks have been widely used on oil and gas storage and transportation purpose. Tanks with deep
drawing technology can be made to hold pressure about 256psi or more than this. No matter vertical
tanks or horizontal tanks or small tanks to huge tanks, we are capable of design and manufacture all
of them for you according to your specifications. For example extreme temperatures for tanks
installation temperatures ranging from minus 60° C to 200° C, we are able to coordinate surface to
be prevented from corrosion and keeping your tanks for long life time.
Vehicle
Automobile covering parts are here refers to exterior metal parts and internal metal parts of the
thin steel plate that covers engine, chassis, cabinet, wheel hubs and body. Jingjiang is capable of
achieving small parts such as motor housing to big parts like engine cover parts. The material of
automobile covering parts is thin and the shape is complicated as well. Outer door panel deep
drawing depth less than 50mm, metal water tank which feature is complex but deep drawing depth less
than 100mm.

### Our Industry Services

Ceeto has been providing custom metal stamping services for various industries and delivering deep
draw component solutions to customers worldwide on time.
Energy Storage
Ceeto has been providing lots of battery cases and enclosures in energy storage industries. With the
rapid development of national economy, the demand for energy is increasing day by day. Traditional
fossil energy is increasingly consumed and brings serious environmental pollution. The integrated
grid-connection of renewable energy and the peak regulation and frequency modulation of large-scale
power grid are inseparable from advanced energy storage technology. The flow battery not only
ensures the storage of intermittent energy sources such as solar, wind and tidal power, but also
converts electricity from off-peak to peak demand, thus maintaining a stable balance of power
consumption and enhancing the stability of the grid.
Medical Device Components
Ceeto is proud to design and manufacture metal medical sterilizer mainly using high-level stainless
steel material and to offer customized solutions for a wide range of metal applications. From
developing the initial prototype product design and building a prototype to manufacturing the
finished high quality products. In medical sterilizer, especially medical barrel which much more
complex with deep drawing technology up to depth 650mm, as well as laser cutting, bending, argon arc
welding, laser welding and high quality surface treatment.
Military & Defense
Material properties and applications can be divided into structural materials and functional
materials, which are mainly used in the ordnance industry. Structural materials mainly use
mechanical and physical and chemical properties of materials to meet the requirements of high
strength, high stiffness, high hardness, high temperature resistance, wear resistance, corrosion
resistance and radiation resistance. At present, metal materials applied in the military field
mainly include the following categories such as magnesium alloy, high-strength steel and Advanced
titanium alloy.
Oil & Gas
Metal tanks have been widely used on oil and gas storage and transportation purpose. Tanks with deep
drawing technology can be made to hold pressure about 256psi or more than this. No matter vertical
tanks or horizontal tanks or small tanks to huge tanks, we are capable of design and manufacture all
of them for you according to your specifications. For example extreme temperatures for tanks
installation temperatures ranging from minus 60° C to 200° C, we are able to coordinate surface to
be prevented from corrosion and keeping your tanks for long life time.
Vehicle
Automobile covering parts are here refers to exterior metal parts and internal metal parts of the
thin steel plate that covers engine, chassis, cabinet, wheel hubs and body. Jingjiang is capable of
achieving small parts such as motor housing to big parts like engine cover parts. The material of
automobile covering parts is thin and the shape is complicated as well. Outer door panel deep
drawing depth less than 50mm, metal water tank which feature is complex but deep drawing depth less
than 100mm.

Our Advantages
Dongguan Fortuna is a production enterprise specializing in precision metal stamping parts,
precision CNC processing, injection molding and product assembly.
[
][124]
[Design and R&D capabilities][125]
Our factory has strong design and R&D capability and 8 R&D personnel responsible for mold design and
technical evaluation with more than 10 years of experience in the stamping and CNC filed.
[
][126]
[one-stop service][127]
Fortuna has its own complete quality control system for strictly controling the quality of all
finished products and a favorable product delivery time, ensuring satisfactory one-stop service for
customers.
[
][128]
[Meet Needs][129]
Fortuna currently has 85 sets of punching machines tonnage from 25T to 300T and 42 imported Japanese
CNC lathes, which can fully meet the diverse requirements of customer products .
[
][130]
[Advanced Eouipment ][131]
With the introduction of low-speed wire cutting machines (MITSUBISHI SEI BU), milling machines,
grinding machines and other equipment, we are able to produce a variety of hard and high-precision
metal-grade progressive dies with stable quality.
[
][132]
[Quality Control Committed to 0PPM ][133]
We have established a rigorous quality management system that spans the entire process. Through
advanced testing equipment and a continuously improving quality management system, we provide our
customers with stable, reliable, and high-quality products.

Custom Service

Fortuna has its own processing equipment for independent product processing, production and
inspection, which greatly speeds up delivery and enhances quality control. It also boasts a
reputable professional after-sales team offering comprehensive services for metal stamping parts.

## What’s in the bottom of your tank?

### Do you know? Do you want to?
### **You should!**

### FAQ of Our Customers

**What's in your tank? Do you know? Do you want to?**
**We do!**

We get a lot of questions and there are some that are asked a lot in this business. Here are just a
few...
I think I have water in my fuel, how can I tell?

Pulling a fuel sample from the bottom of the tank is the most accurate way to know.

Water is heavier than fuel!!

My equipment/engine stopped or is sluggish, can you help?

**Probably! **
You might want to check your fuel filters.

If they are a mess, the problem is almost certainly in your tank!

Does algae really grow in diesel?

**Nope!** Algae is a nickname for degraded fuel.

**SIDENOTE:** Microbial growth (mold, yeast, & fungus) can grow in some biodiesel and certainly in
water in fuel.

What is this slimy garbage in my filters?

Could be a couple of things:

Very likely, it is microbial growth.
* If it is cold, it could be biodiesel contents or your fuel gelling.
* If the problem goes away as temperatures rise, it is most likely your fuel gelling.

What is this stuff that looks like coffee grounds?

Mostly, we call that non combustible particulate matter (sand, dust, rust, maybe a bug or a few
hundred). 

All fuel tanks are vented. Whatever is going on outside your fuel tank, very often makes its way
inside too!

## What’s in the bottom of your tank?

### Do you know? Do you want to?
### **You should!**

### FAQ of Our Customers

**What's in your tank? Do you know? Do you want to?**
**We do!**

We get a lot of questions and there are some that are asked a lot in this business. Here are just a
few...
I think I have water in my fuel, how can I tell?

Pulling a fuel sample from the bottom of the tank is the most accurate way to know.

Water is heavier than fuel!!

My equipment/engine stopped or is sluggish, can you help?

**Probably! **
You might want to check your fuel filters.

If they are a mess, the problem is almost certainly in your tank!

Does algae really grow in diesel?

**Nope!** Algae is a nickname for degraded fuel.

**SIDENOTE:** Microbial growth (mold, yeast, & fungus) can grow in some biodiesel and certainly in
water in fuel.

What is this slimy garbage in my filters?

Could be a couple of things:

Very likely, it is microbial growth.
* If it is cold, it could be biodiesel contents or your fuel gelling.
* If the problem goes away as temperatures rise, it is most likely your fuel gelling.

What is this stuff that looks like coffee grounds?

Mostly, we call that non combustible particulate matter (sand, dust, rust, maybe a bug or a few
hundred). 

All fuel tanks are vented. Whatever is going on outside your fuel tank, very often makes its way
inside too!

## Fuelfix Fuel storage solutions and Low Emission Equipment for hire in action

#### Battery Power for Sustainable Site Operations with Ertech

Perth, WA [VIEW PROJECT][88]
About the Project

Ertech, a leading civil and electrical contractor, sought alternatives to standard diesel generator
to power one of their site's operations requiring continuous power for site offices, crib rooms, and
ablutions.

Fuelfix designed a hybrid solution incorporating a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) paired with
solar arrays.

#### Powering NRW's Operations with Low Emissions Solutions

North-West of Newman, WA [VIEW PROJECT][89]
About the Project

NRW Civil & Mining contacted Fuelfix with an essential project requirement for a remote iron ore
mine site in Newman. They needed an efficient and reliable refuelling solution meeting stringent
operational standards.

Fuelfix designed a hybrid solution incorporating a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) with a
diesel generator.

#### Delivering a reliable and greener Fuel Storage Solution for a mine

Peel region, WA [VIEW PROJECT][90]
About the Project

A mining operator reached out to Fuelfix for their fuel facility extension project. The client
required two new fuel storage and dispensing facilities to be strategically set-up in 2 different
locations on the mine site.

Fuelfix introduced its hybrid-powered refuelling solution to facilitate the refuelling of heavy
vehicles and machinery.

#### Data Driven Decarbonisation Strategies for Sojitz Blue

Gregory Coal Mine, Crinum, QLD [View Project][91]
About the Project

Mining operations are expected to be more efficient in their use of hydrocarbons and are looking for
tangible strategies to immediately reduce their scope 1 and scope 2 CO2 emissions, whilst
maintaining operational reliability and cost efficiency.

With an overarching goal to reduce fuel consumption, improve asset utilisation, and reduce
maintenance costs Fuelfix designed a clear pathway for Sojitz to target those key deliverables.

#### Powering Construction Sites with Low Emissions Solutions

Eglinton, WA, Australia [View Project][92]
About the Project

In a first for Western Australia, Cedar Woods launched WA’s first-ever residential community energy
sharing network as part of Eglinton Village estate development.

Fuelfix was commissioned to provide a temporary reliable, scalable and low emissions power solution
for the project to reduce fuel reliance and resultant emissions. Fuelfix Hybrid Power Systems were
the ideal solution for the project.

#### Enhanced Safety and Efficiency at Bravus Mining’s Aerodrome

Carmichael Mine, QLD, Australia [VIEW PROJECT][93]
About the Project

Bravus Mining and Resources, a prominent player in the mining industry and long-standing customer of
Fuelfix approached us to provide effective and low-emissions lighting solutions for the Labona
Aerodrome, facilitating after dark flights.

Fuelfix provided efficient and low maintenance lighting solutions incorporating hybrid and solar
lighting towers.

#### Enhancing Operational Efficiency for open-pit mining

Coober Pedy, SA, Australia [VIEW PROJECT][94]
About the Project

A long lasting-customer of Fuelfix & Tanks2Go, a leader in the mining industry, approached us to
assess the hydrocarbon installations of their newly acquired mine site located north of Port Augusta
in Sout Australia.

We developed a plan to ensure the critical infrastructure was operating safely, efficiently and
effectively and introduced our innovative battery-powered refuelling solution.

#### Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil (HVO) Fuel Storage Solution

Pilbara Region, WA [View Project][95]
About the Project

As the world transitions towards a low emissions future, the demand to combine traditional fuels
with renewable and next generation alternatives continues to gain pace. Fuelfix is committed to
helping its customers in their journey to a clean energy future.

In response to operational requirements, Fuelfix developed an HVO fuel storage solution for a trial
on the use of HVO at one of our major client’s mine sites in Western Australia’s Pilbara region.

#### Battery Power for Sustainable Site Operations with Ertech

Perth, WA [VIEW PROJECT][88]
About the Project

Ertech, a leading civil and electrical contractor, sought alternatives to standard diesel generator
to power one of their site's operations requiring continuous power for site offices, crib rooms, and
ablutions.

Fuelfix designed a hybrid solution incorporating a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) paired with
solar arrays.

#### Powering NRW's Operations with Low Emissions Solutions

North-West of Newman, WA [VIEW PROJECT][89]
About the Project

NRW Civil & Mining contacted Fuelfix with an essential project requirement for a remote iron ore
mine site in Newman. They needed an efficient and reliable refuelling solution meeting stringent
operational standards.

Fuelfix designed a hybrid solution incorporating a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) with a
diesel generator.

#### Delivering a reliable and greener Fuel Storage Solution for a mine

Peel region, WA [VIEW PROJECT][90]
About the Project

A mining operator reached out to Fuelfix for their fuel facility extension project. The client
required two new fuel storage and dispensing facilities to be strategically set-up in 2 different
locations on the mine site.

Fuelfix introduced its hybrid-powered refuelling solution to facilitate the refuelling of heavy
vehicles and machinery.

#### Data Driven Decarbonisation Strategies for Sojitz Blue

Gregory Coal Mine, Crinum, QLD [View Project][91]
About the Project

Mining operations are expected to be more efficient in their use of hydrocarbons and are looking for
tangible strategies to immediately reduce their scope 1 and scope 2 CO2 emissions, whilst
maintaining operational reliability and cost efficiency.

With an overarching goal to reduce fuel consumption, improve asset utilisation, and reduce
maintenance costs Fuelfix designed a clear pathway for Sojitz to target those key deliverables.

Eglinton, WA, Australia [View Project][92]

In a first for Western Australia, Cedar Woods launched WA’s first-ever residential community energy
sharing network as part of Eglinton Village estate development.

Fuelfix was commissioned to provide a temporary reliable, scalable and low emissions power solution
for the project to reduce fuel reliance and resultant emissions. Fuelfix Hybrid Power Systems were
the ideal solution for the project.

#### Enhanced Safety and Efficiency at Bravus Mining’s Aerodrome

Carmichael Mine, QLD, Australia [VIEW PROJECT][93]

Fuelfix approached us to provide effective and low-emissions lighting solutions for the Labona
Aerodrome, facilitating after dark flights.

Fuelfix provided efficient and low maintenance lighting solutions incorporating hybrid and solar
lighting towers.

A long lasting-customer of Fuelfix & Tanks2Go, a leader in the mining industry, approached us to
assess the hydrocarbon installations of their newly acquired mine site located north of Port Augusta
in Sout Australia.

We developed a plan to ensure the critical infrastructure was operating safely, efficiently and
effectively and introduced our innovative battery-powered refuelling solution.

#### Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil (HVO) Fuel Storage Solution

Pilbara Region, WA [View Project][95]
About the Project

As the world transitions towards a low emissions future, the demand to combine traditional fuels
with renewable and next generation alternatives continues to gain pace. Fuelfix is committed to
helping its customers in their journey to a clean energy future.

In response to operational requirements, Fuelfix developed an HVO fuel storage solution for a trial

## Why Choose Fuel Logic?

We’ll fill up your tank wherever you are, whenever you need it.

Just show up and drive. It’s that simple and convenient!


### On-Demand Fuel Nationwide

Coverage gaps and inconsistent service across multiple locations cost you time and money. Fuel Logic
operates in all 48 states with centralized scheduling and billing, so your entire operation runs on
one reliable account, no matter where your fleet is.


### No BS Fuel Delivery

No surprise charges, no long-term contracts, no runaround. We show up when we say, deliver exactly
what you ordered, and send a transparent invoice. You stay in the loop at every step, and you can
stop anytime.


### Custom-Tailored Fuel Management

Complex operations and spread-out locations need a fueling plan that actually fits. We take time
upfront to map your schedule, your locations, and your fleet needs, then build a custom plan that
keeps costs predictable.

**At the end of the day, we make sure Fuel Logic makes good sense for you.
[ Contact us][109] any time 24/7 to get started.**

## Our Fuel Supply Advantage

### **We Deliver More than Fuel**

Running a fleet means managing fuel as seriously as managing your equipment. That’s why we built our
nationwide operation around reliability from source to site.

We Deliver More Than Fuel – we source it. That means we partner directly with certified refineries
across the nation, manage our own distribution network, and control quality at every step. When you
work with Fuel Logic, you’re working with a company that owns its supply chain instead of just
placing orders.

[On site diesel fuel]

## Why this matters to you:

### Direct Sourcing Relationships:

We purchase fuel at wholesale rates from multiple refineries nationwide, eliminating middleman
markups that other delivery companies pass to you. Our volume allows us to negotiate better
[pricing][110] that goes straight to your bottom line.

### Distributed Inventory Management:

Our network includes strategically positioned fuel depots across the country. This means faster
delivery times, better availability during peak seasons, and the ability to manage your fuel
inventory without having to stock extra tanks.

### Consistent Product Availability:

When construction season hits or winter demand spikes, smaller regional fuel companies struggle with
supply constraints. Our nationwide supply relationships ensure consistent delivery even during
high-demand periods or emergency situations.

### Quality Control Throughout Transport:

Our logistics team tracks fuel from the refinery through our depots to your site. This prevents
contamination issues and ensures you receive the exact product you ordered, at the specifications
you need.

This supply chain infrastructure is why Fuel Logic can promise 24/7 availability nationwide, without
the supply constraints that limit regional competitors.

[let’s talk][111]
[Fuel Logic Fuel Delivery]

## Still Searching For Diesel Fuel Delivery Near You?

### Fuel Logic Fuel Delivery service is always near.

Fuel Logic, one of the leading fuel delivery companies, understands the critical role that diesel
plays in your operations. Whether you’re running a fleet of trucks, managing a [construction
site][112], or operating a farm, having a reliable source of diesel is essential. That’s where we
come in.

#### 24/7 Availability

We offer around-the-clock diesel delivery, ensuring that you have the fuel you need, whenever you
need it.

#### High-Quality Diesel

We are committed to providing only the highest quality diesel to ensure optimal performance of your
equipment and vehicles.

#### Customer Satisfaction

Prioritizing our customers, we ensure exceptional service and satisfaction with every delivery.

Choosing Fuel Logic for your diesel needs means choosing a partner that is committed to supporting
your operations and helping your business succeed.

Contact us today to learn more about our diesel delivery services.

## On-Road Ultra-Low Sulfur Diesel (ULSD)

EPA-approved for all highway diesel engines. Our ULSD formulation includes detergents that keep
injectors clean and reduce particulate matter. For fleets running newer emissions-compliant
equipment, this ensures optimal fuel economy and engine performance.

## Off-Road Dyed Diesel

For construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial generators. Our dyed diesel meets
ASTM D975 specifications and includes rust and corrosion inhibitors to protect injectors and fuel
systems on equipment that sits for extended periods between use.

## Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)

Modern diesel engines require DEF to meet emission standards. We supply DEF meeting ISO 22241
specifications in multiple formats: direct tank injection, 2.5-gallon jugs, 55-gallon drums, and
bulk totes. Proper DEF quality prevents equipment malfunction and expensive repairs that come from
using substandard fluid.

## Gasoline for Commercial Applications

From landscaping equipment to backup generators, our gasoline includes fuel stabilizers and
detergents appropriate for the equipment’s duty cycle and storage requirements.


## Why Consistent Product Quality Matters

Using inconsistent or lower-grade fuel suppliers creates hidden costs: carbon buildup requiring more
frequent injector cleaning, potential injection system failures, reduced fuel economy, increased
emissions system stress. When you shift suppliers trying to save a few cents per gallon, you often
spend more on equipment maintenance.

We guarantee consistent product [filtered fuel to produce the highest quality][113] because we
control our supply relationships and source directly from certified refineries.

## Why Choose Fuel Logic?

We’ll fill up your tank wherever you are, whenever you need it.

Just show up and drive. It’s that simple and convenient!


### On-Demand Fuel Nationwide

Coverage gaps and inconsistent service across multiple locations cost you time and money. Fuel Logic
operates in all 48 states with centralized scheduling and billing, so your entire operation runs on
one reliable account, no matter where your fleet is.


### No BS Fuel Delivery

No surprise charges, no long-term contracts, no runaround. We show up when we say, deliver exactly
what you ordered, and send a transparent invoice. You stay in the loop at every step, and you can
stop anytime.


### Custom-Tailored Fuel Management

Complex operations and spread-out locations need a fueling plan that actually fits. We take time
upfront to map your schedule, your locations, and your fleet needs, then build a custom plan that
keeps costs predictable.

**At the end of the day, we make sure Fuel Logic makes good sense for you.
[ Contact us][109] any time 24/7 to get started.**

## Our Fuel Supply Advantage

### **We Deliver More than Fuel**

Running a fleet means managing fuel as seriously as managing your equipment. That’s why we built our
nationwide operation around reliability from source to site.

We Deliver More Than Fuel – we source it. That means we partner directly with certified refineries
across the nation, manage our own distribution network, and control quality at every step. When you
work with Fuel Logic, you’re working with a company that owns its supply chain instead of just
placing orders.

[On site diesel fuel]

## Why this matters to you:

### Direct Sourcing Relationships:

We purchase fuel at wholesale rates from multiple refineries nationwide, eliminating middleman
markups that other delivery companies pass to you. Our volume allows us to negotiate better
[pricing][110] that goes straight to your bottom line.

### Distributed Inventory Management:

Our network includes strategically positioned fuel depots across the country. This means faster
delivery times, better availability during peak seasons, and the ability to manage your fuel
inventory without having to stock extra tanks.

### Consistent Product Availability:

When construction season hits or winter demand spikes, smaller regional fuel companies struggle with
supply constraints. Our nationwide supply relationships ensure consistent delivery even during
high-demand periods or emergency situations.

### Quality Control Throughout Transport:

Our logistics team tracks fuel from the refinery through our depots to your site. This prevents
contamination issues and ensures you receive the exact product you ordered, at the specifications
you need.

This supply chain infrastructure is why Fuel Logic can promise 24/7 availability nationwide, without
the supply constraints that limit regional competitors.

## Still Searching For Diesel Fuel Delivery Near You?

### Fuel Logic Fuel Delivery service is always near.

Fuel Logic, one of the leading fuel delivery companies, understands the critical role that diesel
plays in your operations. Whether you’re running a fleet of trucks, managing a [construction
site][112], or operating a farm, having a reliable source of diesel is essential. That’s where we
come in.

#### 24/7 Availability

We offer around-the-clock diesel delivery, ensuring that you have the fuel you need, whenever you
need it.

#### High-Quality Diesel

We are committed to providing only the highest quality diesel to ensure optimal performance of your
equipment and vehicles.

#### Customer Satisfaction

Prioritizing our customers, we ensure exceptional service and satisfaction with every delivery.

Choosing Fuel Logic for your diesel needs means choosing a partner that is committed to supporting
your operations and helping your business succeed.

Contact us today to learn more about our diesel delivery services.

## On-Road Ultra-Low Sulfur Diesel (ULSD)

EPA-approved for all highway diesel engines. Our ULSD formulation includes detergents that keep
injectors clean and reduce particulate matter. For fleets running newer emissions-compliant
equipment, this ensures optimal fuel economy and engine performance.

## Off-Road Dyed Diesel

For construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial generators. Our dyed diesel meets
ASTM D975 specifications and includes rust and corrosion inhibitors to protect injectors and fuel
systems on equipment that sits for extended periods between use.

## Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)

Modern diesel engines require DEF to meet emission standards. We supply DEF meeting ISO 22241
specifications in multiple formats: direct tank injection, 2.5-gallon jugs, 55-gallon drums, and
bulk totes. Proper DEF quality prevents equipment malfunction and expensive repairs that come from
using substandard fluid.

## Gasoline for Commercial Applications

From landscaping equipment to backup generators, our gasoline includes fuel stabilizers and
detergents appropriate for the equipment’s duty cycle and storage requirements.


## Why Consistent Product Quality Matters

Using inconsistent or lower-grade fuel suppliers creates hidden costs: carbon buildup requiring more
frequent injector cleaning, potential injection system failures, reduced fuel economy, increased
emissions system stress. When you shift suppliers trying to save a few cents per gallon, you often
spend more on equipment maintenance.

We guarantee consistent product [filtered fuel to produce the highest quality][113] because we
control our supply relationships and source directly from certified refineries.

Efficient, Innovative Fuel Solutions for a Sustainable and Cleaner Future

## Welcome To Fuel Total Systems

Fuel Total Systems Kentucky Corporation (formerly known as FTS California Corporation) was
established in Lathrop, CA in 2001 and began producing fuel tanks for Toyota Corolla and Tacoma in
2003. In 2004, the CA plant sent the first shipment of tanks to their customer.

Expansion of FTSKY and the construction of a new site in Lebanon, KY began in 2008. The building was
completed in October of 2010, and less than one year later in August 2011, the first shipment of
Corolla Tanks were delivered to TMMMS (Toyota Motor Manufacturing). Mass production of the Corolla
fuel filler pipes began in July 2013, with shipments being made to TMMMS and TMMC (Toyota Motor
Manufacturing Canada).

FTSKY
FTSTN

In July 2017, FTSKY sent their first shipment of Toyota Camry fuel tanks and fuel filler pipes to
TMMK (Toyota Motor Manufacturing Kentucky). In the spring of 2018, shipments to TMMK increased with
the addition of fuel tank and fuel filler pipe business for Toyota Avalon and Lexus ES.

Fuel Total Systems Tennessee, LLC is our newest North American expansion project that was completed
in 2019. The FTSTN Team was very excited to make their first shipment of Toyota Corolla fuel tanks
to TMMMS (Toyota Motor Manufacturing Mississippi) in March 2020.

### ISO 14001 certification was achieved in October 2013 at the Kentucky location, awarded by
### Intertek.

## Welcome To Fuel Total Systems

Fuel Total Systems Kentucky Corporation (formerly known as FTS California Corporation) was
established in Lathrop, CA in 2001 and began producing fuel tanks for Toyota Corolla and Tacoma in
2003. In 2004, the CA plant sent the first shipment of tanks to their customer.

Expansion of FTSKY and the construction of a new site in Lebanon, KY began in 2008. The building was
completed in October of 2010, and less than one year later in August 2011, the first shipment of
Corolla Tanks were delivered to TMMMS (Toyota Motor Manufacturing). Mass production of the Corolla
fuel filler pipes began in July 2013, with shipments being made to TMMMS and TMMC (Toyota Motor
Manufacturing Canada).

FTSKY
FTSTN

In July 2017, FTSKY sent their first shipment of Toyota Camry fuel tanks and fuel filler pipes to
TMMK (Toyota Motor Manufacturing Kentucky). In the spring of 2018, shipments to TMMK increased with
the addition of fuel tank and fuel filler pipe business for Toyota Avalon and Lexus ES.

Fuel Total Systems Tennessee, LLC is our newest North American expansion project that was completed
in 2019. The FTSTN Team was very excited to make their first shipment of Toyota Corolla fuel tanks
to TMMMS (Toyota Motor Manufacturing Mississippi) in March 2020.
